Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary use: PHI processing for post-visit care summarization and patient triage.
- Volume: ~2M tokens/month initially, ramping to ~10M within 12 months.
- Key constraints: HIPAA compliance (+ BAA), SOC2 evidence for internal audit, and preference to isolate PHI (customer asked about Dedicated vs Private VPC).

Next steps I'm proposing:
1) Share Redwood SOC 2 Type II report and a draft BAA for Elara review (attached).
2) Loop in our security lead to answer technical evidence/questions.
3) Put together a short matrix comparing Hosted API (with BAA), Dedicated (reserved GPU pools), and Private VPC / on-prem tradeoffs (security, latency, cost, timeline).
4) Draft a mutual action plan & timeline so procurement knows the steps.

Attaching: Redwood_Security_Sheet_v2.pdf (high level), SOC2_Type2_report_2026.pdf, BAA_Draft_Elara.docx, deployment-options-matrix.xlsx (initial).

Questions for you to help prioritize:
- Is Elara comfortable starting on Hosted API under a BAA for a pilot, or do you need Dedicated/Private before any PHI is processed?
- Who from legal/procurement should I include for the BAA loop?

Happy to join a short 30-minute follow-up to walk through the documents.

Thanks,

Thanks Dylan — really helpful recap. A few quick notes/questions: 

- We do handle PHI and our security/compliance team requires SOC2 Type II evidence. Appreciate the report attached; I'll run it by our InfoSec.
- For a pilot we prefer to avoid sending live PHI to a multitenant Hosted environment without explicit controls. If Hosted API under a BAA can guarantee encryption at rest, TLS, and no retention of PHI (or strong options to opt-out), we might consider a redacted pilot. Can Neha confirm those retention/retention-zero controls?
- If not, our preference order is: Dedicated (isolated GPU pools with customer-scoped tenancy) -> Private VPC -> On-prem.

Can you also confirm typical timeline and uplift in cost for Dedicated vs Hosted (rough numbers are fine for procurement)? Procurement wants an initial MLP cost estimate and a sample mutual action plan.

Please loop in the security person and solutions engineer and include procurement@elarahealth.com.

Thanks Sarah — looping in Neha (Security) and Marissa (Solutions) to address retention and cost/timeline questions. Marissa / Neha: can you confirm the following items for Elara?

1) Retention/PHI handling on Hosted API:
   - By default Hosted API does not persist prompts/responses beyond short-term logs used for reliability; we offer an option to disable all logging for a customer and disable data retention. With a BAA, we can commit to no retention of PHI and provide access logs/audit trails.
   - All data in transit is TLS 1.2+ and at-rest encryption is AES-256 in our storage layers.

2) SOC2 evidence and process:
   - Attached SOC2 Type II report covers controls through Dec 2026 and is what most customers accept. We can provide additional artifact access under NDA for buyer security teams.

3) Deployment options & uplift estimates (ballpark):
   - Hosted API (BAA): Fastest (1-2 weeks), lowest uplift (~+10-20% over list API pricing for BAA administration & support). Good for redacted or de-identified pilots.
   - Dedicated reserved pool: Timeline ~4-8 weeks (provisioning + onboarding), uplift ~+60-120% depending on GPU size and reservation term (monthly commit). Provides tenant isolation and predictable throughput.
   - Private VPC / On-prem: Timeline 8-12+ weeks (networking, KMS, installation), uplift higher (license + infra ops); ideal for high regulatory/compliance needs.

4) Mutual action plan (proposed):
   - Week 0: Sign mutual NDA + BAA, agree pilot scope (redacted dataset or synthetic PHI).
   - Week 1-2: Hosted pilot (if acceptable) or start Dedicated provisioning.
   - Week 3-6: Pilot run + joint evaluation (latency, quality, cost).
   - Week 6-10: Decide scale path (stay Hosted with protections / move to Dedicated / Private).

Marissa: can you attach a short Dedicated vs Private matrix with expected provisioning steps, and a sample procurement cost range for the initial commit? Neha: would appreciate a one-page note confirming retention controls and what artifacts we can share via NDA.

Sarah / Tom / procurement: is Thursday 3/18 at 10am PT good for a 30-minute follow-up to go over the SOC2 artifacts and the mutual action plan?

Thanks all —
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Quick security note from me:

- Retention: We can enforce zero retention for an account under contract. Operationally that means request/response logs are disabled and we can purge any ephemeral logs. We can also provide periodic audit exports of access logs.
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest. For Dedicated and Private VPC we support customer-managed KMS keys (Bring Your Own Key).
- SOC2 artifacts: SOC2_Type2_report_2026.pdf (attached) covers the controls Elara will care about. If you need deeper artifacts (control tests, exception reports), we can share under NDA and with a JIT access window.
- BAA: The attached BAA_Draft_Elara.docx is a starting point. Legal teams typically take 1-3 weeks for a first pass.
- Evidence for procurement: we can provide a short evidence pack (1-2 pages) summarizing controls for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private; Marissa will attach the matrix.

On the Hosted pilot question: it's feasible to run a pilot on Hosted if Elara is comfortable with a no-retention contract and the BAA terms. If Elara requires tenant isolation for any PHI on day 1, Dedicated is the safer option.

Happy to join Thursday's call — 10am PT works for me as well.

-Neha
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
